# Normalized system model

> Generated by `tools/` from the inputs in `source/`. Every statement below is backed by assembly metadata, IL, or a supplied export sample.
> Anything that could not be proven from those inputs is marked **Unknown** rather than guessed.

A serialization-independent view of a Barsa system. Every collection below
exists because a table backing it was observed in a supplied sample. Collections
with no such table are present but marked Unknown, per spec section 26.

## Shape

```json
{
  "system":       { "id": null, "name": null, "sourceTable": "MET_METASYSTEM" },
  "entities":     [],
  "fields":       [],
  "relationDefs": [],
  "relations":    [],
  "reports":      [],
  "folders":      [],
  "code":         [],
  "commands":     [],
  "views":        [],
  "forms":        null,
  "workflows":    null
}
```

`forms` and `workflows` are `null`, not `[]`. An empty array would assert that a
system has none; `null` says this pack cannot tell.

## Unknown handling

Per spec section 28, an unresolved scalar is `null` and an unresolved collection
is `null` — never a guessed default. A consumer must not fill these in.

Machine-readable: `models/normalized-system-model.schema.json`,
`models/sample-normalized-system.json`, `index/normalized-model.json`.
